title: Stokes formula on a cube for current slices: the action of ∂([[Q_r]] × Y) is the face terms plus (−1)^k times that of [[Q_r]] × ∂Y
statement:
Let P, j, m, n' ∈ ℕ, k := j + 1, and let g = (g_0, …, g_j) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) be orthonormal with span G; for a ∈ Fin (j + 1) let g^(a) := g ∘ a.succAbove (g with g_a removed) and G_a := span g^(a). Let h : n' = (j + 1) + m, h₁ : n' + 1 = (j + 1) + (m + 1) and h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1). Let Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) have an integer multiplicity representation R_Y, and let X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with ∂Y = X (Y.boundary = X). Let flatD : Λ^{n'+1} → Λ^{m+1}, flat : Λ^{n'} → Λ^m and flatF a : Λ^{n'} → Λ^{m+1} (a ∈ Fin (j + 1)) be continuous linear maps with flatD α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h₁), flat α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h) and flatF a α v = α(Fin.append g^(a) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂) (interior products with g, resp. g^(a)). Let ω be a test n'-form, dω its exterior derivative, r > 0, H^i := μHE[i], Q_r := {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i} and Q'_a := {s ∈ G_a : |⟨g_{a.succAbove c}, s⟩| ≤ r for all c}. Writing Y(φ), X(φ) for currentEval of the form y ↦ φ(y), we have
∫_{Q_r} Y(y ↦ flatD(dω(t + y))) dH^{j+1}(t) = Σ_{a ∈ Fin (j+1)} (−1)^a·[∫_{Q'_a} Y(y ↦ flatF a(ω(s + r·g_a + y))) dH^j(s) − ∫_{Q'_a} Y(y ↦ flatF a(ω(s − r·g_a + y))) dH^j(s)] + (−1)^{j+1}·∫_{Q_r} X(y ↦ flat(ω(t + y))) dH^{j+1}(t).
